sources.observation: The entrance wing has deep arched bays, stone plinths, exposed columns and a pitched slate roof under a cliff overhang.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: The white arcade follows the sloping stone court. Curved and triangular entrance screens rise above two of the five entrances.

limitations: The arcade bays, cave openings and overhanging rock surface are exterior interpretations. The interiors and frescoes are outside scope.
